headline: Faster chat, cleaner conversations, and smoother mobile tools.
highlights: Chat messages appear immediately while sending, group more naturally, and use compact reply, reaction, and message-action controls.
Chat Info now provides focused Message and Search actions plus organized Media, Files, Links, and safety controls on desktop and mobile.
The Android QR scanner responds faster, uses one targeting indicator, and clearly separates QR verification from attendance confirmation.
Team access and attendance controls are easier to understand, while Android chat surfaces use a more consistent neutral dark theme.
